scope: PDF 1–2 (printed 121–122), experimental details and 174.1-keV gated spectrum, Eqs. (1)–(4), and figures comparing data with model curves.

works.gap: No tabular raw intensities, quantified P, polarization setup, independent mixing-ratio determination or absolute lifetimes from this acquisition.
